qa-checklist-templates-runbook.note: The inherited QA article contained fabricated release observations, unsupported defect-rate claims, rigid checklist-size rules, and invented benchmarks. The effective public record is rewritten as a bounded checklist-design and execution protocol with explicit expected results, exception handling, ownership, and checklist revision after real misses.

structure-writing-with-visuals.note: The inherited writing article contained fabricated usability observations, unsupported comprehension and support-ticket improvements, and arbitrary layout thresholds. The effective public record is rewritten as a document-structure review protocol in which headings, tables, diagrams, and images are chosen only when they answer a reader question or make a relationship easier to inspect.

chef-taste-and-adjust.note: The inherited cooking article contained fabricated kitchen/lab outcomes, pseudo-precise seasoning rules, unsupported physiological claims, and unsafe overgeneralization of tasting. The effective public record is rewritten as a conservative taste-and-adjust workflow for food that is already safe to taste, with one change at a time and explicit food-safety boundaries.

build-your-support-network.note: The inherited support-network article contained fabricated response rates and observational samples, rigid contact targets, broad psychological claims, and pseudo-optimized social scripts. The effective public record is rewritten as a consent- and boundary-aware method for matching a concrete need to an appropriate person, making a specific optional request, and avoiding overreliance on one relationship.
